en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'Копшара' is my reading as 'pigpen/small shed' (uncertain dialect word). 'Мора лага да прозбориш' is rendered 'you are bound to tell a lie', my reading.

words_to_learn.en: you cook up, you devise (lit. cut out)

lines.cyr: А бре Ѓоре, Ѓоре, лажго Ѓоре,
lines.lat: A bre Ǵore, Ǵore, lažgo Ǵore,
lines.en: Hey Gjore, Gjore, you liar Gjore,
hey Gjore, you liar Gjore,
when you open your mouth, hey,
you are bound to tell a lie,
when you close your mouth, hey,
then you cook up a new lie.

lines.cyr: А бре Ѓоре, Ѓоре, лажго Ѓоре,

hey Gjore, you liar Gjore,

lines.cyr: на моми се фалиш, збориш море,
lines.lat: na momi se fališ, zboriš more,
lines.en: you boast to the girls, you say, hey,
that you have a new house,

lines.cyr: а ти немаш ни копшара море,
lines.lat: a ti nemaš ni kopšara more,
lines.en: but you do not even have a pigpen, hey,
let alone a new house.
